scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc6 -p tsconfig.concord.json && pnpm --filter @niceeval/repo-tools run typecheck && pnpm --filter @niceeval/e2e-runner run typecheck && pnpm --filter @niceeval/testkit run typecheck && pnpm --filter niceeval run typecheck && pnpm exec tsc6 -p test/tsconfig.property.json
scripts.lint:docs-site: pnpm run repo docs site prepare && concurrently --names validate,links "pnpm run repo docs site validate" "pnpm run repo docs site links"
scripts.lint:oxlint: oxlint --threads=4 packages/*/src packages/*/scripts apps test e2e .github/scripts
scripts.site:dev: pnpm --filter niceeval run build:package && pnpm --filter @niceeval/site run dev
scripts.site:build: pnpm --filter niceeval run build:package && pnpm --filter @niceeval/site run build:deploy
